initial_units.coptic_label: Diplomatic opening (Codex II, p. 32 — after Coptic Scriptorium NHAM.02)
initial_units.english: These are the secret sayings that the living Jesus spoke and Didymus Judas Thomas wrote down.
initial_units.english_source: Display rendering aligned to Coptic Scriptorium diplomatic (not Lambdin/Robinson copyrighted editions)

initial_units.english: Jesus said: Let one who seeks continue seeking until he finds. When he finds, he will be troubled, and when he is troubled he will marvel and will reign over the All.
initial_units.english_source: Display rendering; Greek overlap in P.Oxy. 654 follows Grenfell & Hunt 1904 (PD) where applicable

initial_units.english: Jesus said: If those who lead you say to you, 'See, the kingdom is in heaven,' then the birds of heaven will precede you.
initial_units.english_source: Display rendering aligned to diplomatic Coptic
